name: mutlumehmet-agent-skills
description: Agent Skills for everyday work with Claude

plugins.name: create-project
plugins.description: Sets up a new project folder the same way every time: asks a few questions, then creates the folder, an optional cloud-synced assets folder git never sees, CLAUDE.md and STATUS.md, and an optional private GitHub repo.

plugins.name: save-context
plugins.description: Before you close a session, saves what it decided, changed and left open: shows one plan, writes STATUS.md, memory and registers after approval, hands items to the skills that own them, and commits only what it touched without pushing.
